## Loading Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(eurostat)
library(here)
library(stringr)

conf_data <- readxl::read_excel(here("data/raw", "data.xlsx"), na = c("", "NA", "N/A"), col_types = "text")
```

## Filter Speech

```{r}
speech_filter <- conf_data |>
  unite("speech",
        Presentation_Text1,
        Presentation_Text2,
        Presentation_Text3,
        Presentation_Text4,
        na.rm = T) |>
  select(
    year = Conference_Year,
    speaker = Person,
    speech) |>
  mutate(speech = na_if(speech, "")) |>
  mutate(speaker = speaker |>
           str_to_lower() |>
           str_trim()
         ) |>
  drop_na() |>
  group_by(speaker) |>
  mutate(speaker_id = cur_group_id()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(speech_id = row_number()) |>
  select(
    speech_id,
    speaker_id,
    speaker,
    year,
    speech
  )
```

## Output File

```{r}
write.csv(speech_filter, "../data/processed/speeches.csv", row.names = F)
```
